name: Tai Fu-ku
bio: Tai Fu-ku is dated by Giles to the 12th and 13th centuries AD. His poem here is a summer scene.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Summer
poems.author: Tai Fu-ku
poems.text:
When ducklings seek the puddles, mostly dry,
In the hot plum-time,,with its changeful sky,
'Tis then in shady arbour we carouse,
And strip the golden loquat from the boughs.

poems.title: 月夜舟中 (Yue ye zhou zhong)
poems.author: Tai Fu-ku
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
滿船明月浸虛空，綠水無痕夜氣衝。
詩思浮沈檣影裏，夢魂搖拽櫓聲中。
星辰冷落碧潭水，鴻雁悲鳴紅蓼風。
數點漁燈依古岸，斷橋垂露滴梧桐。
